sections.text: Jingshui Fu added 33.12 points to reach 33.22, leaping from 3,527th to 68th on ARC-AGI-3.
That move carries Fu into the top 100 in a field of 4,205 teams, turning a deep-board position into a place among the contest’s leading contenders.
